# Moonlight SK1 Texture v14 — HEVC 4K HDR on Ugoos SK1

**Status: pre-release / owner-tested diagnostic build.**

**Real-world result on Ugoos SK1 (Amlogic S928X-K, Android 14):** the owner reports smooth **HEVC 4K HDR** game streaming from Sunshine with subjectively minimal input latency. Earlier Moonlight V+ and standard Moonlight versions stuttered severely on HEVC on this same device.

This result is **specific to the tested Ugoos SK1**, not a verified general fix for all Android TV devices. No independently measured latency in milliseconds is claimed.

## Availability / important limitation

**The tested v14 APK is not yet attached to this GitHub release.** The user-provided APK exists outside GitHub, and the available automated publisher cannot access that upload directly. **Do not download the autogenerated “Source code” ZIP expecting it to contain the tested v14 build.**

To complete binary publication, attach the *exact* `Moonlight-SK1-Texture-v14-crop-test-noautoupdate.apk` to this release and verify the SHA-256 above. The binary should be published together with its **complete corresponding source code** under the upstream project's GPLv3 license. The corresponding full v14 implementation has **not yet** been committed; the files in this tag are research notes and an independently reconstructed geometry parser, **not** the exact original v14 source.

## Technical research

v14 adds handling of HEVC SPS conformance-window geometry, `MediaCodec` output crop metadata, and Android `SurfaceControl` crop/scale transactions. An example is the 3840×2176 coded buffer with a 3840×2160 visible frame. The independent HEVC SPS parser and regression tests are in `research/sk1-v14`. These do **not** prove which change caused the observed smoothness.

- [Technical APK analysis](https://github.com/DHBender/moonlight-vplus_UGOOS_SK1/blob/release/sk1-texture-v14/research/sk1-v14/README.md)
